masteryReview.reason: Current 15 provisional groups are broad cross-topic labels, not validated skills. INTEGER_FEASIBILITY and LINEAR_SYSTEM_TRANSFER especially mix multiple topics; do not award separate credit solely by question ID, and do not interpret a broad group as a single mastered skill. Keep source lineage, primary topic and specific target skill separate. Key distribution skew must be addressed or verified shuffled in runtime before use.

limits: AI second pass, not external reviewer. All 39 keys rederived, eight targeted revisions rechecked.
